{{Top|leg}}
'''Okonomo''' was a paradise-like island located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Every [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Grand Alderaanian Gathering]] was held there, at the luxurious [[Okonomo Retreat]]. Around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the island was the stage of the so-called [[Okonomo Tragedy]], during which the crazed [[Geneticist/Legends|geneticist]] [[Zeta Magnus]] unleashed a [[hive virus]] that caused all the attendees of the Grand Gathering to [[Cannibalism|devour]] each other.
